title: APGAP Influenza Pipeline
description: Parameters for the APGAP influenza whole-genome analysis workflow.

reads_dir.title: Reads directory
reads_dir.description: Directory containing paired-end FASTQ files. Recommended for standard runs.

reads.title: Reads glob pattern
reads.description: Optional glob pattern for paired-end FASTQ files. Use this instead of reads_dir when you need a custom file match.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Directory where pipeline outputs will be written.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of CPU threads used by multi-threaded processes.

host.title: Host category
host.description: Host category used for subtype interpretation and review flags.

primers_5p_r1.title: R1 5' primer sequences
primers_5p_r1.description: Optional 5' primer sequences to trim from R1 reads.

primers_5p_r2.title: R2 5' primer sequences
primers_5p_r2.description: Optional 5' primer sequences to trim from R2 reads.

cutadapt_min_overlap.title: Cutadapt minimum overlap
cutadapt_min_overlap.description: Minimum overlap required for primer trimming.

cutadapt_error_rate.title: Cutadapt error rate
cutadapt_error_rate.description: Maximum error rate allowed during primer trimming.

coverage_threshold.title: Coverage threshold
coverage_threshold.description: Minimum median depth required for a segment to be classified as PASS.

subtype_min_median_depth.title: Subtype minimum median depth
subtype_min_median_depth.description: Minimum median depth required for subtype support.

subtype_min_breadth.title: Subtype minimum breadth
subtype_min_breadth.description: Minimum breadth of coverage required for subtype support.

subtype_minor_fraction.title: Subtype minor fraction
subtype_minor_fraction.description: Secondary-to-dominant subtype depth fraction used to identify low-level or mixed subtype signals.
